I saved your correction and replied to you in the #north-random thread. My notes now say the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due 24 September, replacing the 20 November date from your #north-team post this morning.

- **The old note is still there.** I tried to remove the 20 November entry but couldn't, so both are saved. The new one says it replaces the old one. I haven't checked either date against the order form itself.
- **24 September has already passed.** Today is 14 October, so I asked you whether you meant next year's date or whether the form is already signed.
- **My reply mentions the 20 November date.** June Osei-Lark can read #north-random but isn't in #north-team. That seemed fine to me: a deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and June runs the deal desk.
